scripts.compose: npm run init && docker compose up --build -d
scripts.dev: npm run init && concurrently --kill-others --names api,ssg "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix ssg run dev"
scripts.dev:api: npm run init && npm --prefix api run dev
scripts.dev:ssg: npm run init && npm --prefix ssg run dev
scripts.build: npm run init && npm --prefix api run build && npm --prefix ssg run build
scripts.build:api: npm run init && npm --prefix api run build
scripts.build:ssg: npm run init && npm --prefix ssg run build
scripts.preview: npm run init && concurrently --kill-others --names api,ssg "npm --prefix api run preview" "npm --prefix ssg run preview"
scripts.preview:api: npm run init && npm --prefix api run preview
scripts.preview:ssg: npm run init && npm --prefix ssg run preview
scripts.deploy: npm run init && npm --prefix api run deploy && npm --prefix ssg run deploy
scripts.deploy:api: npm run init && npm --prefix api run deploy
scripts.deploy:ssg: npm run init && npm --prefix ssg run deploy
scripts.desktop:frontend:build: node scripts/prepare-licenses.mjs && npm --prefix ssg run build -- --mode desktop
